method: 内置图片生成，多视角整站参考与空间补充
adopted_palette: 天穹联合工业（AUI）；沿用本站蓝白、浅灰配色，不新增制造商全局配色定义

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: detailed Minecraft Java 1.21.1 architectural reference for one integrated standard construction-material assembly port owned by Aether Union Industries (AUI).
Create a coherent multi-view architectural sheet showing ONE COMPLETE IDENTICAL SITE, not a modular kit or four separate buildings. Four carefully consistent views: large front-left three-quarter perspective, large rear-right three-quarter perspective, clear top-down block-grid site plan, and a front entrance/structural bay close-up to establish scale. Crisp vanilla Minecraft block materials, physically buildable voxel details. Neutral warm-white studio background and neutral daylight, no dramatic fog or terrain landscape. Fill the canvas with useful architecture and clear sightlines.
Design: elongated asymmetrical industrial campus on ONE continuous low ground plinth, roughly 78 blocks across X by 48 blocks deep Z, approximately 23 blocks total height including foundations; long side may exceed64, DO NOT make a square or up-scale doors. Footprint has a stepped concave recess at the front-right corner: main left workshop/yard bar plus a right-rear projecting helicopter-like cargo apron. Low plinth 2-3 blocks deep with inset foundations, not a tall floating fortress. Four connected functional zones plus ONE built-in open-air H landing apron. Their roofs/walkways/plinth are linked, not four free detached buildings.
Composition seen from front (-Z): left-front compact two-floor registration/reception office in blue and white with a glazed corner lookout, normal double doorway, clear exterior 3-block stair to upper-floor gallery. Left-rear main assembly hall with broad open tall front entrance, repeated 5-block portal-frame bays, shallow gable roof with a narrow raised longitudinal daylight monitor; white slender outer portal ribs and muted deep-blue metal-like roof panels with gray seams. One low glass-roof side aisle on its right contains an EMPTY greenhouse frame mockup. Main hall includes only a small EMPTY modular cabin skeleton; otherwise uncluttered accessible floors. At front-middle is a lower open-sided dual-bay material canopy and 4 EMPTY shallow stock bays, timber support racks with no goods. On the right side of the workshop bar, a long open interface demonstration gallery has three visibly different upright connector-frame exhibits on a one-block raised podium, a slim partial canopy and steps at both ends. A continuous 4-5 block walking route links office, stockyard, workshop, gallery and pad without passing through the landing area.
Right projecting apron: a full clear25x25 square cargo operating area with flush white H, thin yellow safety outline, two small white/blue open equipment alcoves on its far-right rim, both opening to SAME H pad. Border railings and edge lights outside clear square only. Absolutely no beams, overhead crane, roof or bridge over this landing surface; sky stays clear. Rear or inner-side personnel connection to gallery. Only one H in entire site. No runways, cars, ships or extra landing pads.
Scale discipline: ordinary door leaves exactly2 blocks tall, stairs3 blocks wide, normal room clear height4 blocks, standard column1-2 blocks thick, major hall bays5 blocks long, outer framing up to2 blocks thick. Show clear voxel grid, a 1-block scale grid in top plan, overall target dimensions, and annotated2-block door and3-block stair in closeup; do not trust tiny text alone, visible blocks should demonstrate scale. Keep floor plans, roof ridges, exits and staircase locations consistent across views. Front public access from south of drawing (-Z), back +Z.
Palette: AUI site blue and off-white characteristic panels, light gray masonry floors, medium gray trim, small dark structural details, natural wood rack accents, yellow safety lines. Deliberate layered bases, window frames, slab-thickness fascias, gutters, joints, railings, entrance canopy and lamps, without random greebles. No BDS green or HEC red corporate scheme. No iron blocks, gold blocks, diamond blocks, netherite blocks, emerald blocks, beacons. Other vanilla materials freely allowed. No furniture, stacked inventory, functional business equipment, people, terrain trees, flying craft, floating text labels over the building or decorative logos. Only architectural scale notes and view labels may appear. Produce a precise rich reference suitable for manual reconstruction, not a gigantic miniature city.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the adopted reference design, not something to redesign. Create ONE complementary architectural reference sheet of exactly the same integrated AUI Standard Construction Material Assembly Port. Retain blue and white material palette, stepped low stone plinth, front-left small glazed registration office with external3-wide stair, front low timber/glass material canopy, three connector exhibits at front-right of workshop bar, five-bay long gabled assembly hall behind them with a central roof monitor and glass side aisle, and ONE H cargo pad projecting on right. Preserve the image's proportions and recognizable forms. Target whole footprint78X by48Z and roof height around24, door leaf2blocks high, office floors clear4blocks, portal-bay centers6blocks, maintenance steps3blocks wide. This sheet ONLY supplies missing rear elevations and spatial connectivity, not more buildings.
Three panels: (1) large near-orthographic REAR elevation with readable rear hall wall, window groups, exterior plinth and right projecting cargo pad. (2) large cutaway three-quarter view REMOVE ONLY the main hall's roof in this view, showing its empty usable floor, repeated portal ribs, a small empty cabin skeleton off the central walking lane, glass side greenhouse-frame aisle, normal doors, and linked routes to the reception and pad. Furniture and industrial machines remain absent. (3) clear top-down schematic site plan on one-block grid, explicit -Z front at bottom, X right, highlighting a walking route around rather than across the25x25 H area. Long hall roof ridge runs along X, not Z. The main hall front elevation opens toward the front public promenade; its back wall is enclosed with high windows. Show office upper-floor landing connected to its exterior stair. The pad equipment sheds both face the same single landing area; no beam or crane above it. Do NOT show any second H or detached duplicate pad.
Keep all buildings together on the same connected base. No city expansion, new road network, vehicles, people, text-heavy specs, unrealistically thin cantilevers, or new towers. Daylight with neutral background, crisp vanilla Minecraft block geometry and textures. No banned resource blocks: iron block, gold block, diamond block, netherite block, emerald block, beacon. Label only 'REAR', 'ROOF REMOVED', 'PLAN', and optional dimension/door scale notes. An architectural completion of reference details for building the real NBT.
